accepted.reason: Stack exhaustion on a crafted brace pattern. No patched release exists (every version up to the latest, 3.0.3, is affected). It reaches the tree only through jscpd 4 (jscpd > @jscpd/finder > fast-glob > micromatch > braces), a development tool run by hand as `npm run dupcheck` on this repository's own src/ with a fixed ignore pattern; it is not packaged and never sees untrusted input. jscpd 5 drops the chain but reports a different duplicate count, so moving to it is an owner decision.

A prototype pollution that already exists on the page can bypass KaTeX's trust setting. This is the KaTeX 0.16.47 copy that Mermaid's own build inlines in mermaid.min.js; the newest Mermaid (12.1.0) still depends on katex ^0.16.47, so no release fixes it. The app's own math rendering uses the vendored KaTeX 0.18.9, which is not affected, and Mermaid runs with securityLevel 'strict'.
